description: Replace your current API key using current authenticated access. Requires confirm:true. Issues the new key ONCE; immediately revokes the old credential and outstanding recovery challenges. Keeps the same agent ID and all linked records. Save the key in operator secret storage and update all integrations; never email it. No payment.

agent_key.description: Private agent key from speedbot_register. Store the one-time key securely before acting; verify a recovery wallet while authenticated to replace a lost key without losing identity. Pass here, or send Authorization: Bearer. Never publish it.
